description: Land Acquistion - Nalagama, Thangalla D/S Division,  Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific lands are needed for a public purpose (laying water transmission lines). It provides detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels, including their extents, boundaries, and current claimants. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related administrative actions.
